task.title: Background color and images
task.shortdesc: A background can have a solid color, one or more images, or both. These properties describe the color and image layers of an element’s background.

info.p: “CSS Backgrounds 4 §2.1, Base Color: the background-color property”.
Use background-color to set a solid color behind an element’s content. Write a CSS color value, such as a named color, a hexadecimal color or an rgb() value.
The CSS initial value is transparent. In CSS, the background color is painted beneath the element’s background images.
“CSS Backgrounds 4 §2.2, Image Sources: the background-image property”.
Use background-image to specify images behind an element’s content. A value can be a url() image, a gradient or none. Separate multiple layers with commas.
The first image in the list is the top layer. Later images are below it, and the background color is below all image layers. Use none when a layer should not show an image.
